editorial:
You drop into a world where the Canary Islands feel like the last safe corner of Europe, and every supply run to the mainland is a gamble. Roberto joins the mission with secrets that make you question every choice he makes, while the rest of the team just wants to bring back enough food and medicine to keep everyone alive. The movie moves fast, mixing tense chases, infected crowds, and arguments among the crew. It feels like a survival trip where nobody fully trusts anyone, and that tension keeps you alert from the first scene.

The action scenes are loud and messy in a good way, and the infected attacks feel dangerous without turning into nonstop chaos. Some characters get better development than others, and a few plot turns are easy to guess, but the strong pacing and solid performances help carry the weaker moments. If you enjoy zombie thrillers with teamwork problems and moral choices, this is a fun night watch. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or add the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection if you want the sharpest picture.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Roberto finally reveals he was sent to secure a cure sample, not just supplies. The team reaches the extraction point, but a horde surrounds them. Roberto sacrifices himself to hold the infected back while the others escape with the sample. The last shot shows the sample arriving safely in the Canary Islands, while a radio message hints another faction may already be infected. You are left knowing the mission worked, but the bigger danger is still out there.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie thrillers, survival missions, and tense team drama.
